reuse.why: It uses the existing forEachMonthWideCategory, which handles the category selection, income/tracking filtering and batching, together with getSheetValue, setBudget and the mutator(undoable(...)) registration.

duplication.why: No selection logic is copied. The income/expense sign flip repeats the small inline pattern set3MonthAvg and setNMonthAvg already use instead of sharing it.

placement.why: The action sits beside the other month-wide actions in budget/actions.ts, and the handler is registered in budget/app.ts next to its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Small, follows the established pattern, and inherits any future change to which categories month-wide actions fill.
